{{Quote|Dewback Kord over there, he's a ship’s mechanic.|Rondle|<ref name="WS" />}}
'''Dewback Kord''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] on the [[Hawkbat (starship)|''Hawkbat'']], a [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] in the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] Kord and a few of the ''Hawkbat's'' crew were treated to drinks by [[Yokel Group]], members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], during their [[Mission to Storinal|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]] in order to gather information.<ref name="WS" />
